title: Credit Standing on a Crop Input Purchasing Account: Past Due, Suspension and Reinstatement
content:
An account of the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts is flagged past due once an invoice has stood unpaid for the programme's past-due trigger in calendar days beyond its due date, and the flag comes off only when nothing on the account is overdue, not merely when the oldest invoice is cleared.

**Suspension.** Buying is suspended when the oldest overdue invoice reaches the programme's suspension trigger in days, or at any time once the overdue balance reaches the programme's suspension threshold, whichever comes first; the threshold bites on its own, so a large balance one day overdue can suspend an account that the day count alone would not.

**What suspension touches.** Suspension stops new product leaving the plant and does not disturb product already delivered, prepay already booked or custom application work already scheduled.

**Reinstatement.** The words that stood here — *"Buying is reinstated when the member pays at least the programme's reinstatement share of the overdue balance, and reinstatement is recorded by the credit department rather than at the counter, however plainly the member says the payment has been sent."* — are **no longer in force** on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts, having been superseded by the current basis on which the share the member must remit is worked out. Reinstatement remains a matter recorded by the credit department, on the cooperative's own record of the account — its credit standing, the balance on it and its reference number — and not on the member's statement that the money has been sent.

**Grain coming in.** A member whose grain settlement will clear the balance within days may ask for the suspension to be lifted early against that settlement, and that is a judgement the credit department makes and no rule here settles.

## Two triggers, whichever comes first

| The record shows | Buying is |
| --- | --- |
| Oldest overdue invoice short of the programme's suspension trigger in days, overdue balance below the programme's suspension threshold | Not suspended on either ground |
| Oldest overdue invoice at the programme's suspension trigger in days | Suspended |
| Overdue balance at the programme's suspension threshold, one day overdue | Suspended on the threshold alone |
| Nothing overdue on the account | The past-due flag comes off |
| The oldest invoice cleared, a later one still overdue | The flag stands |

The past-due trigger, the suspension trigger, the suspension threshold and the reinstatement share are each the figure the member's programme carries in the credit department rate table.

superseded_clauses: Buying is reinstated when the member pays at least the programme's reinstatement share of the overdue balance, and reinstatement is recorded by the credit department rather than at the counter, however plainly the member says the payment has been sent.
